2608.03782.title: KnowHal: A Knowledge-Driven Benchmark for Comprehensive Multimodal Hallucination Evaluation
2608.03782.paper_summary: Hallucination remains a critical challenge for developing trustworthy Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While existing benchmarks mainly focus on entity, attribute, and relation hallucinations, knowledge-related failures are often investigated separately, lacking a unified evaluation framework across different hallucination dimensions. To overcome this, we propose \textbf{KnowHal}, a benchmark that explicitly incorporates knowledge hallucination into multimodal hallucination evaluation spanning four dimensions: entity, attribute, relation, and knowledge. KnowHal constructs paired positive and negative questions over shared images and entities, enabling controlled comparisons among perceptual errors, knowledge-related errors, and false-premise acceptance. The benchmark contains 1,800 samples across 10 domains and 50 categories, constructed through a semi-automated pipeline combining LLM assistance, CLIP-based filtering, and human verification. We evaluate 14 representative MLLMs on KnowHal and conduct extensive analyses. Results show that the knowledge dimension consistently presents the greatest challenge for nearly all evaluated models, while most models exhibit substantial performance degradation on negative questions, revealing limited robustness to false premises. By unifying four hallucination dimensions with paired question design, KnowHal addresses an important gap in existing evaluation frameworks and enables a more comprehensive assessment of hallucinations in MLLMs.
2608.03782.paper_summary_zh: 幻覺仍然是開發可信賴的多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）的一個關鍵挑戰。雖然現有的基準主要集中在實體、屬性和關係幻覺上，但知識相關的失誤通常是單獨調查的，缺乏跨不同幻覺維度的統一評估框架。為了克服這一點，我們提出了\textbf{KnowHal}，這是一個明確將知識幻覺納入多模態幻覺評估的基準，涵蓋四個維度：實體、屬性、關係和知識。KnowHal在共享的圖像和實體上構建了成對的正向和負向問題，使得在感知錯誤、知識相關錯誤和錯誤前提接受之間進行受控比較成為可能。該基準包含來自10個領域和50個類別的1,800個樣本，通過結合LLM輔助、基於CLIP的過濾和人工驗證的半自動化流程構建。我們在KnowHal上評估了14個具有代表性的MLLMs並進行了廣泛的分析。結果顯示，知識維度對幾乎所有評估模型始終構成最大的挑戰，而大多數模型在負向問題上表現出顯著的性能下降，顯示出對錯誤前提的穩健性有限。通過成對問題設計統一四個幻覺維度，KnowHal填補了現有評估框架中的一個重要空白，並使對MLLMs中幻覺的更全面評估成為可能。
